scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Welcome to Morocc,
the frontier town of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
Please ask me for help if
you're having any trouble
finding anything in town.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
欢迎来到梦罗克，
卢恩·米德加兹王国的边境城镇。
如果您在城镇中找不到任何地方，
请随时向我求助。

[Morocc Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.

显示位置标记，
请让我为您

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
魔法和科技的进步
让我们更新了资讯系统，
现在可以在小地图上
标记位置，
以便更轻松地导航。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
小地图位于屏幕的右上角。
如果您看不到它，
请按Ctrl + Tab键，
或点击基础信息窗口中的
“地图”按钮。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
在小地图上，
点击“+”和“-”符号
可以放大或缩小地图。
祝您在梦罗克城
旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Alright then,
try to stay out of
too much trouble
out there, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
那么，
在外面小心点，
别惹太多麻烦，
冒险者。
